command:
set -u
printf '%s\n' '---HTTPS LS-REMOTE---'
git ls-remote https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/oMEGA.git refs/heads/main 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '---RAW ASSEMBLY HEAD---'
python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request
url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gschaidergabriel/oMEGA/427cca1300ed597687d720aa94cc1a54cc5abdb5/config/assembly.json'
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=15) as r:
        b=r.read(160)
        print('HTTP', r.status, 'BYTES_PREFIX', b.decode('utf-8','replace'))
except Exception as e:
    print(type(e).__name__, e)
PY
